title: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1
summary: The Colossal Titan breaches the outer wall of Shiganshina, allowing Titans to invade and devour Eren's mother.

title: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 2
summary: The Armored Titan destroys Wall Maria's inner gate, forcing refugees to retreat behind Wall Rose as Eren vows to eliminate all Titans.

title: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback, Part 1
summary: Eren, Mikasa, and Armin begin training with the 104th Cadet Corps, where Eren overcomes difficulties with his maneuvering equipment.

title: The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback, Part 2
summary: The 104th Cadet Corps graduates, but the Colossal Titan suddenly reappears at the gate of Trost District just as Eren prepares to join the Scout Regiment.

title: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost, Part 1
summary: Titans flood into Trost District, and Eren is swallowed by a Titan after saving Armin from being eaten.

title: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost, Part 2
summary: Armin grieves Eren's apparent demise while Mikasa protects retreating civilians and recalls how Eren inspired her will to survive.

title: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost, Part 3
summary: Stranded cadets lose hope due to depleted gas supplies until Mikasa rallies them and a mysterious rogue Titan begins attacking other Titans.

title: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost, Part 4
summary: Armin uses the rogue Titan to clear the supply depot, and the cadets watch in shock as Eren emerges alive from its nape.

title: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost, Part 5
summary: Suspicious Garrison troops surround Eren and his friends, forcing Eren to partially transform into a Titan to block cannon fire.

title: Response: The Struggle for Trost, Part 6
summary: Commander Dot Pyxis intervenes to stop the Garrison's attack and enlists Eren's Titan abilities for a counteroffensive to seal the wall.

title: Idol: The Struggle for Trost, Part 7
summary: Pyxis rallies the terrified troops to support the mission, but Eren loses control and attacks Mikasa immediately after transforming.

title: Wound: The Struggle for Trost, Part 8
summary: Armin brings an unconscious Eren back to his senses while the elite Garrison squad fights to defend him from encroaching Titans.

title: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost, Part 9
summary: Eren carries the giant boulder to seal the breach in Wall Rose, securing humanity's first victory against the Titans.

title: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 1
summary: Eren stands trial before a military tribunal, where Levi beats him to persuade the judge to place him under Scout Regiment custody.

title: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 2
summary: Eren is relocated to the Scout Regiment's former headquarters with Levi's squad, while Hange demonstrates experiments on captured Titans.

title: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 3
summary: Following the mysterious deaths of the captured Titans, Erwin hosts the recruitment ceremony where Eren's close friends enlist in the Scouts.

title: Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 1
summary: The Scout Regiment launches their expedition outside the walls, where an intelligent Female Titan appears and tears through the formation.

title: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 2
summary: Erwin directs the Scouts into the Forest of Giant Trees as the Female Titan continues her relentless pursuit of Levi's squad.

title: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 3
summary: Eren chooses to trust Levi's squad instead of transforming, leading the Female Titan directly into Erwin's hidden ambush.

title: Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 4
summary: The Scouts fail to extract the human from the restrained Female Titan before she lets out a scream summoning Titans to devour her body.

title: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 5
summary: The Female Titan ambushes and annihilates Levi's squad, driving an enraged Eren to transform and fight her before being defeated.

title: The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 6
summary: Levi and Mikasa successfully rescue Eren from the Female Titan, but the Scout Regiment returns to Wall Sina in bitter defeat.

title: Smile: Assault on Stohess, Part 1
summary: Armin lures Annie Leonhart into an ambush in Stohess District, where she is unmasked as the Female Titan and transforms.

title: Mercy: Assault on Stohess, Part 2
summary: Overcoming his initial disbelief, Eren transforms into a Titan to confront Annie as she rampages through Stohess District.

title: Wall: Assault on Stohess, Part 3
summary: Eren and the Scouts defeat Annie before she encases herself in crystal, after which a dormant Titan is discovered inside Wall Sina.

title: Beast Titan
summary: A talking Beast Titan leads an unexpected horde of Titans into Wall Rose, killing Section Commander Miche.

title: I'm Home
summary: Sasha rescues a young girl in her home village while Connie discovers an immobilized Titan inside his destroyed family home in Ragako.

title: Southwestward
summary: Scout squads search the wall for breaches before taking refuge for the night at the ruins of Utgard Castle.

title: Soldier
summary: Surrounded by Titans active at night, senior Scouts die defending the castle tower until Ymir unexpectedly transforms into a Titan to protect the cadets.

title: Historia
summary: Ymir battles the Titan horde to save her comrades, after which Christa reveals her true identity as Historia Reiss just as reinforcements arrive.

title: Warrior
summary: Reiner and Bertholdt reveal their identities as the Armored and Colossal Titans before transforming to kidnap Eren and Ymir.

title: Close Combat
summary: Eren uses Annie's martial arts grappling techniques to battle the Armored Titan until the Colossal Titan collapses upon them from above.

title: The Hunters
summary: Reiner and Bertholdt escape with the captured Eren and Ymir into the Forest of Giant Trees as Erwin organizes a rescue party.

title: Opening
summary: As Eren and Ymir regenerate their severed limbs, Reiner suffers a mental crisis between his identities as a soldier and a warrior.

title: Children
summary: Ymir's tragic past is revealed, leading her to capture Historia before fleeing alongside Reiner and Bertholdt with the Scouts in pursuit.

title: Charge
summary: Erwin leads a charge of wild Titans against the Armored Titan, allowing the Scouts to rescue Eren before the Smiling Titan confronts him.

title: Scream
summary: Hannes dies protecting Eren, triggering Eren to awaken the Coordinate ability to control Titans and drive the enemy away.

title: Smoke Signal
summary: Levi's newly assembled squad goes into hiding after Pastor Nick is murdered, but Kenny the Ripper ambushes Levi in Trost.

title: Pain
summary: Levi escapes Kenny's ambush and the Scouts capture Interior MPs to uncover Lord Rod Reiss's plot to seize Eren and Historia.

title: Old Story
summary: Historia recounts her childhood while Erwin outlines his plan for a bloodless military coup against the corrupt royal government.

title: Trust
summary: Marlo and Hitch aid the fugitive Scouts, while Hange helps Flegel Reeves expose the Military Police's crimes to the public.

title: Reply
summary: A staged Titan invasion during Erwin's trial exposes the government's callousness, allowing the military to overthrow the royal council.

title: Sin
summary: Chained in a crystal cavern, Eren recalls eating his father Grisha and discovers Grisha stole the Founding Titan from the Reiss family.

title: Wish
summary: Historia rejects her father's demand to devour Eren and breaks the syringe, driving a desperate Rod Reiss to ingest the serum himself.

title: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
summary: Eren uses an Armor bottle to harden his Titan and save the squad, while the Scouts prepare to intercept Rod's colossal Titan at Orvud.

title: Ruler of the Walls
summary: The Scouts blow apart Rod Reiss's crawler Titan at the walls of Orvud, allowing Historia to deliver the fatal blow before the citizens.

title: Friends
summary: A dying Kenny recalls his past with Uri Reiss and gives Levi a stolen Titan injection before Historia is officially crowned Queen.

title: Bystander
summary: Commander Keith Shadis reveals how he first met Grisha Yeager twenty years earlier and his role in Eren's childhood.

title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
summary: The Scouts receive an enthusiastic send-off from the citizens of Trost on the eve of their crucial mission to reclaim Wall Maria.

title: The Town Where Everything Began
summary: The Scouts reach Shiganshina and plug the outer gate before Reiner ambushes them and the Beast Titan traps them with an army of Titans.

title: Thunder Spears
summary: The Scouts use newly developed Thunder Spears to bypass the Armored Titan's defenses and shatter Reiner's nape.

title: Descent
summary: Bertholdt is catapulted into Shiganshina and transforms into the Colossal Titan, unleashing a devastating explosion.

title: Perfect Game
summary: Pinned down by lethal boulder barrages from the Beast Titan, Erwin leads a suicidal charge to create an opening for Levi.

title: Hero
summary: Levi brutally dismantles the Beast Titan while Armin sacrifices himself in scalding steam so Eren can defeat the Colossal Titan.

title: Midnight Sun
summary: Levi makes the agonizing decision to revive a dying Armin instead of Erwin by feeding Bertholdt to him.

title: The Basement
summary: Eren and the Scouts unlock Grisha's basement desk and discover a photograph revealing advanced human civilization beyond the walls.

title: That Day
summary: Eren experiences Grisha's memories of Eldian oppression in Marley, the tragic death of his sister, and the origins of the Restorationists.

title: Attack Titan
summary: Grisha receives the Attack Titan from Eren Kruger, while present-day Eren realizes how he previously activated the Founding Titan.

title: The Other Side of the Wall
summary: Humanity reclaims Wall Maria and the Scouts reach the ocean, where Eren somberly contemplates the enemies awaiting across the sea.

title: The Other Side of the Sea
summary: Marley concludes its four-year war against the Mid-East Allied Forces at Fort Slava through the brutal deployment of its Titans.

title: Midnight Train
summary: Returning home to Liberio, Zeke proposes a festival to announce the renewed campaign to retake the Founding Titan from Paradis.

title: The Door of Hope
summary: Reiner reflects on his painful childhood as a Warrior Candidate and his infiltration of Paradis, deciding against suicide for the next generation.

title: From One Hand to Another
summary: Willy Tybur prepares the festival with Commander Magath, while Falco unwittingly leads Reiner into a basement to confront Eren.

title: Declaration of War
summary: Willy Tybur reveals the true history of King Fritz and declares global war on Paradis just as Eren transforms and kills him.

title: The War Hammer Titan
summary: Eren battles the formidable War Hammer Titan in Liberio until Mikasa and the Scout Regiment arrive to provide reinforcement.

title: Assault
summary: Armin obliterates Marley's naval fleet as the Colossal Titan, while Eren uses the Jaw Titan's teeth to devour the War Hammer.

title: Assassin's Bullet
summary: Gabi infiltrates the retreating Scout airship and fatally shoots Sasha before discovering Zeke's covert cooperation with Paradis.

title: Brave Volunteers
summary: Flashbacks reveal how Yelena and the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers assisted Paradis, as the Scouts mourn Sasha's tragic death.

title: A Sound Argument
summary: Hizuru's envoy proposes exploiting the island's resources under Zeke's plan, while tensions escalate over Eren's rogue actions.

title: Deceiver
summary: Gabi and Falco escape custody and are taken in by Sasha's family, unaware of their hosts' connection to their victim.

title: Guides
summary: Premier Zachary is assassinated by a bomb, paving the way for Eren's escape and the rise of the rebel Jaegerist faction.

title: Children of the Forest
summary: Nicolo uncovers Gabi's identity and reveals that Marleyan wine distributed to the military was laced with Zeke's spinal fluid.

title: Savagery
summary: Eren cruelly alienates Armin and Mikasa, while Levi slaughterously neutralizes his transformed squad to recapture the Beast Titan.

title: Sole Salvation
summary: Zeke recalls his tragic bond with Tom Xaver and his euthanasia ideology before detonating a Thunder Spear against Levi.

title: Above and Below
summary: Pieck leads Eren into an ambush on Shiganshina's roof as Marleyan airships descend from the sky to launch a full-scale invasion.

title: Judgment
summary: Marley launches an airborne invasion of Shiganshina, forcing Eren to battle Reiner and Porco alone.

title: Sneak Attack
summary: Zeke arrives as the Beast Titan to support Eren, but Marley's forces critically wound him with an anti-Titan cannon.

title: Two Brothers
summary: Zeke screams to turn tainted soldiers into Titans before Gabi decapitates Eren, whose head lands in Zeke's hand to enter the Paths.

title: Memories of the Future
summary: Traveling through Grisha's memories, Zeke realizes Eren used the Attack Titan's future sight to manipulate their father into slaughtering the Reiss family.

title: From You, 2,000 Years Ago
summary: Eren convinces the enslaved Founder Ymir to grant him her power, unleashing the Wall Titans to begin the Rumbling.

title: Thaw
summary: As the Wall Titans march to destroy the world, the Scouts eliminate the remaining Pure Titans in Shiganshina and Annie emerges from her crystal.

title: Sunset
summary: The aftermath of the wall collapse divides Paradis, while Hitch discovers Annie and helps her flee the capital.

title: Pride
summary: Hange and a wounded Levi form an alliance with Magath and Pieck, while Connie abandons his plan to feed Falco to his mother.

title: Night of the End
summary: Former enemies among the Scouts and Warriors gather around a campfire to confront their shared past and unite to stop the Rumbling.

title: Traitor
summary: The united Alliance attempts to secure the Azumabito flying boat at the port, forcing them to fight and kill former comrades among the Jaegerists.

title: Retrospective
summary: The Alliance secures the flying boat to escape by sea, while Magath and Keith Shadis sacrifice themselves to destroy a captured cruiser.

title: The Dawn of Humanity
summary: Flashbacks recount the Scouts' clandestine visit to Marley, as the Colossal Titans of the Rumbling arrive to trample the global fleet.

title: The Final Chapters: Special 1
summary: The Rumbling devastates humanity across the sea, and Hange sacrifices herself to stall the Colossal Titans so the Alliance can launch the flying boat.

title: The Final Chapters: Special 2
summary: The Alliance battles past Titan shifters atop Eren's Founding Titan, and Mikasa kills Eren to end the Rumbling and rid the world of Titans.
